description: Petroleum and Environmental Management Tool (PEMT) – High Arctic is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada | Relations Couronne-Autochtones et Affaires du Nord Canada. The High Arctic dataset comes from the Petroleum and Environmental Management Tool (PEMT). The online tool was decommissioned in 2019 and the data was transferred to Open Data in order to preserve it. The PEMT was originally developed in 2009 to help guide development in the Canadian Arctic by Indian and Northern Affairs Canada (INAC). Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada | Relations Couronne-Autochtones et Affaires du Nord Canada. Its tags are Petroleum and Environmental Management Tool, PEMT, Environment, Arctic, Canadian Arctic. It offers 28 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, FGDB/GDB, KML, PDF. The portal shows 2025-03-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
